title: SCA Minhag of the Week 292: "Megillah Readings At Home"

chapters.title: The importance of publicizing the miracle
chapters.about: Purim, Megillat Esther, publicizing the miracle

chapters.title: Rabbi Abraham Antebi on private minyanim
chapters.about: Ohel Yesharim, opposition to home readings

summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the importance of reading the Megillah in the Bet Keneset to fulfill the misva of publicizing the miracle of Purim. He reviews the historical opposition of Hachamim to private home readings and explains the differing customs regarding whether to recite berachot when reading the Megillah at home for women.
questions: Why is it preferred to hear the Megillah in the Bet Keneset rather than at home?
What did Rabbi Abraham Antebi say about private minyanim on Purim?
Should a man recite the berachot when reading the Megillah at home for his family?
Does the minhag of Aleppo require a beracha when reading the Megillah at home for women?
